name: OpenApe Grant Gate
description: Routes every agent exec through the DDISA grant flow. Requests with the agent identity, approves with the owner identity, fails closed.

agents.description: Map of OpenClaw agent id to that agent's apes auth home (the directory containing .config/apes/auth.json). Agents missing here are blocked.

apeShellPath.description: Absolute path to the ape-shell binary.

waitTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a grant decision before failing closed.

approvalSurface.description: Where the human is asked. "idp" (default) polls the grant so any IdP surface can decide and works for unattended agents; "openclaw" prompts in-session but requires an interactive channel.
